verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, OAuth and personal-token authentication, an MCP server, a CLI and webhooks, but nothing shows Moneybird publishes official language SDKs or client libraries. The REST API, CLI and MCP are adjacent channels, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so there is no spec-based client generation path either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
